meta.notes: A brick and a lapis lazuli make the sherd. A vanilla pack cannot add an item, so it is a brick carrying vanilla components: minecraft:provides_pottery_pattern names msm_examples:fish_tale, so a decorated pot crafted with it shows the picture on that side; minecraft:item_model and minecraft:item_name give its look and name. Bricks are already pot ingredients, so four bricks or sherds in a diamond make a decorated pot.
